description: FAIRY MUSIC v1.0.2 — Resolved Listen Together playback sync glitch, eliminated endless forward-seeking loops, fixed simultaneous multi-device party audio, and reinforced OTA update permissions.

changelog.title: Listen Together Sync & Stability
items: Fixed playback glitch where songs would desync or rapidly forward/skip back and forth
Removed uncalibrated device-to-server clock skew arithmetic in position syncing
Resolved barrier deadlock so party guests start playing simultaneously when the host plays
Restricted ExoPlayer automated event broadcasting to host-only to prevent echo feedback loops
Guarded queue sync so guest queue state never ping-pongs or resets host playback

changelog.title: Seamless In-App OTA Updates
items: Fully declared and retained android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES in FOSS manifest
Safe in-app package installer launch with zero crashes or forced browser redirects

changelog.title: Account & Login Reliability
items: Google authentication with Chrome 128 mobile User-Agent and third-party cookie sync
NPE protection on altered YouTube account layout headers
